correctness.rationale: The published standard-permutation full-cycle criterion is checked in its exact scope. Starting 1 and ending 0 follows from fixed-point exclusions, forcing even run count. A bijective equality-gap subset parametrization exhausts the only candidates: 48 singleton cases at length 49 with orbit length <49; each of 23 earlier odd lengths has a full-cycle witness; exactly 1128 of the binomial(48,3)=17296 triple-gap cases have full cycles and matching direct BWT. Periodic proper powers cannot have 46 runs at length 49. All finite claims are exhausted by the bundled checker, independently checking LF via sorted stable indices and direct BWT of accepted words; finite claims only.

value.rationale: The binary alphabet is the exceptional case for recent BWT maximal-run constructions. The first failure of the natural parity-bound maximal run count is a motivated structural boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter: all earlier 23 odd lengths attain n-1, whereas length 49 does not. The complete 1128 extremizer census identifies sharp realizations and makes the contrast checkable. It does not purport to settle later lengths, asymptotics or Artin infinitude.
